result.reason: Neither position is satisfied. The redline attempts to add Affiliates and contractors but leaves clause (b)'s third-party consent prohibition unchanged, creating a direct scope conflict. It also omits all required duration, irrevocability, termination, cure, and successor-transfer protections. The added responsibility provision imposes an additional Licensee obligation not required by either position, so the redline is not minimal; the unresolved contradiction also prevents it from preserving intent coherently.
